source_text: Nullam speciem peccatorum Scriptura reticeat. Verbum Dei missum ad sanandos omnem speciem perstringit. Sicut de populo et sacerdotibus et dispensatoribus, ita de veris et falsis prophetis — pseudo-prophetae magistri ecclesiarum non recte sermone vel vita.
pass_a_gloss: Let Scripture keep silent about no kind of sins. The Word of God sent to heal touches every kind. As concerning people and priests and stewards, so concerning true and false prophets — false prophets are church teachers not right in word or life.
pass_b_english: Scripture hides no species of sin; the Word sent to heal names them all. True prophets minister God’s words; [[false prophets >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:1-3]] are teachers whose talk or life denies the discipline they preach.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
